paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amasa bang in suangpek nih bawl inla; hiai suangpekte tung ah, na hihsiat suangpek masapente a om thute ka gelh ding.
heading: Suangpek Nihnate / (Diu 10.1-5)

paite: Zingsang in mansa in om inla, zingsang in Sinai Tang ah hong paitou inla, tang vum ah ka kiang ah hong kihil in.
Na kiang a kuamah ahong paitouh louh ding uh ahi. Tang kimvel a leng kuamah himhim muh a a-om louh ding uh ahi. Tang mazawn lam a bawnghon leh belamhon leng agamtat louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in amasapen bang in suangpek nih abawl hi. Zingkhang in Mosi athou a, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in, Sinai Tang ah ahohtou a, akhut in suangpek nihte atawi hi.
Meipi ah TOUPA ahong kumsuk a, akiang ah ahong dingh a, TOUPA min agenkheta hi.
Huchi in ama ah TOUPA apaisuak a, "TOUPA, TOUPA Pathian, hehpih thei leh it thei, dohthei leh, hoihna leh thutak hau.

Sangte a dia zahngaihna nei, gitlouhna, tatlekna leh khelhna ngaidam, mohna bangchi mah a siangsak lou ding, pate gitlouhna tate tung leh atusuante tung, akhang thumna leh akhang lina tan a thukpa," chi in apuangkhia hi.
Kintak in lei si in Mosi akunsuk a, abeta hi.

Ama'n, "Tu a na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, TOUPA aw, ka hon ngen hi, ka lak uah ka TOUPA pai hen; migenhak ahih ziak un. Ka gitlouhna uleh ka khelhna uh ngaidam inla, na gouluah ding in hon la in," achi hi.

Ama'n: Ngai in, nou toh thukhun ka bawl hi. Leitung pumpi a hih a om ngei lou, koi nam a leng hih a om ngei lou, thillamdangte na mi tengteng ma ah ka hih ding hi. Alak ua na tenna mi tengteng in TOUPA'N nou a dia thil lauhuai ka hih dingte amu ding uh.
heading: Thukhun Thaksak Nawnnanih / (Eks 23.14-19; Diu 7.1-5; 16.1-17)

paite: Nang tuni a ka hon thupiak zui in. Ngai in na ma uah Amorte, leh Kanaante, leh Hitte, leh Perizte, leh Hivte, leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding hi.
Pilvang in, na paina gam a tengte toh thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thang ahi ding uhi.
Amaitamte uh hihsia un, amilimte uh hihgawpsak un, a Asherah songte uh na phuksak ding uh ahi.
Pathian dang na be ding uh ahi kei: TOUPA, amin Mullit hat ahi a, mullit hat Pathian ahi.
Huai gam a teng mite toh kikal ah thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Apathiante uh kiang a kithoihna alat chiang in khattei in ahon chial dia, akithoihna sa uh na ne kha ding uh.
Na tapate a ding in atanute uh na pisak kha ding ua, atanute uh apathiante uh kiang a akizuak chiang un, na tapate uh leng amaute hih bang a, amilimte uh be ding in akhempuk kha ding uhi.
Sunthoh pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.

Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina na nei gige ding uh ahi. Thu ka hon piak tak bang in, Abib kha in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh; Abib kha a Aigupta a pan a na hong paikhiak ziak un.
Sul hong ta masa tengteng, na ganhon lak ua piang masapen teng, bawngtal hi in belam hileh, apa peuhpeuh kei a ahi.

Himahleh sabiltungnou masapen belamnou in na tatkhiak ding uh ahi. Na tatkhiak kei uleh, angawng na hektan ding uh ahi. Na tapate tengteng lak a piang masapen na tatkhiak ding ahi. Ka ma ah kuamah khutvuak in ahong kilang ding uh ahi kei.
Ni guk sung nna na sem ding ahi. Himahleh ani sagih ni in na khawl ding ahi. Haichi pawi hun leh pawltak hun in na khawl ding ahi.
Nipi kalte a ankuangluina, huit buh pawltak gah masa ankuangluina, kum tawp a koihkhawmna ankuang- luinate na tan ding ahi.
Kum khat in thumvei pasal teng- teng Toupa PATHIAN, Israel' Pathian ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
Na mai ua namte ka delhkhe ding a, na gamgi uh ka keklian ding. Kum khat a thumvei TOUPA na Pathian ma a na kilat chiang un, kuamah in na gam uh ahon deihgoh kei ding hi.
"Ka mai a kithoihna thillat; silngou toh sisan na lan ding uh ahi kei. Paikan Ankuanglui kithoihna leng azingchiang tan in nutsiat in a-om ding ahi kei.
Na gam a gah masa hoihpente a masapen TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na hon tawi ding ahi. Kelnou anu' nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai thute gelh in. Hiai thute omdan zui a nang leh Israel toh thukhun ka bawl tak ziak in," achi hi.
TOUPA kiang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli a-om a; an ane kei a, tui leng adawn kei hi. Suangpek tung ah thukhun thute, huai Thupiak Sawmte agelh hi.
Sinai Tang a kipan akhut a theihpihna suangpek nihte tawi a, tang a kipan Mosi ahong paisuk lai in, amah ahoupih sung in amaitang tang ahi chih Mosi in athei kei hi.
heading: Sinai Mual Tung A Pan Mosi Akumsuk

paite: Aaron leh Israel suan tengteng in Mosi amuhtak un, ngai in, amaitang atang a; amah naih a hong pai alauta uhi.
Himahleh Mosi in amaute asam a; Aaron leh mipi kikhawmte heutu tengteng akiang ah ahong kik nawn ua; Mosi in amaute ahoupih hi.
Huai nung in Israel suan tengteng ahong pai nai ua; Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N akiang a agen tengteng thupiak in amaute apeta hi.
Mosi in amaute ahoupih khit in, amaitang khuhna in akhuh hi.
Himahleh TOUPA houpih dia amai alut teng in, ahong pawtkhiak nawn mateng, thupiak a omte Israel suante kiang a agen chiang in, amai khuhna ahawkkhia hi.
Israel suante'n Mosi maitang amu ua, Mosi maivun atang hi. Mosi in amah houpih dia alut nawn matan in amaitang akhuh zel hi.
